# What will selling this rental property actually cost you in tax?

> Free calculator for landlords selling a rental or investment property: estimates depreciation recapture (Section 1250, capped at 25%), remaining capital-gains tax, and Net Investment Income Tax, then shows how much a 1031 exchange would defer. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
